title: Sleepy seal
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f6c66a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='22' fill='#8fb8d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='16' fill='#a8cbe6'/>
  <!-- tail flippers -->
  <path d='M18 74 Q10 70 14 82 Q20 84 22 78 Z' fill='#6f9bc0'/>
  <path d='M82 74 Q90 70 86 82 Q80 84 78 78 Z' fill='#6f9bc0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='19' fill='#a8cbe6'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#cfe6f5'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4a6d8c'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M36 36 Q41 40 46 36' stroke='#3d5a75' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 36 Q59 40 64 36' stroke='#3d5a75' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='45' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e88f9b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='45' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e88f9b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- z's -->
  <path d='M70 22 L76 22 L70 28 L76 28' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 10 L84 10 L80 14 L84 14' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front flipper -->
  <path d='M58 62 Q66 66 62 76 Q56 74 55 66 Z' fill='#7fa9cd'/>
</svg>
